value.rationale: A complete three-regime qualitative sign phase diagram for the non-Gaussian fourth-order chronological asymmetry gives a natural exact classification. A previously known at-least-one-crossing theorem leaves potentially many additional lag reversals; the new result excludes all such switchbacks and proves all-lag fixed signs outside the unique crossing interval. Physical motivation comes from detecting time reversal in a harmonic particle subjected to resetting Brownian memory; this is a structural consequence with meaningful parameter boundaries, not a routine numerical improvement.
